paite: Huan ka dak a, ngai in mi khat akhut a tehna khau tawi ka mu hi!
heading: Tehna Khau Tawimi Muhna

paite: Huai lai in ke'n, “Koilam a hoh ding?" ka chi hi. Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Jerusalem, availam bang tan hi a, adunglam bang tan hiam chih thei ding a teh ding in," ahon chi hi.
Huan ngai in, kei hon houpih angel apaikhia a, amah kituahpih ding in angel dang khat apaikhe nawn hi.
Akiang ah, "Tai inla, huai a tangvalpa kiang ah, Jerusalem zaw asung a mipi tampitak leh ganhonte ziak in, kulhbaang om lou khuate bang in luah in a-om ding a,
huan akimvel a meikuang kulhbaang a umtu ka hi ding a, huchi in asung a athupina ka hih ding ziak in, TOUPA'N achi," chi in.
Khai, khai, mallam gam a kipan taikek un, TOUPA'N achi; van huih lite bang in nou lah ka hon dalhzaksakta ngal a, TOUPA'N achi.
heading: TOUPA'N Zion Adeihsakna

paite: Khai! Zion ah tai in, nang Babulon tanu toh tengkhawm un.
Huchibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, thupina khit in nang hon lok namte kiang ah ama'n kei ahon sawl hi; kuapeuh nang hon khoih in amit nauta khoih ahi.
"Ngai in, atung ua ka khut sing ding ka hi a, huchi in ana uh sepsakte a ding in gallak ahi ding uh; huan sepaihte TOUPA'N kei ahon sawl chih na thei ding uh.
"Aw Zion tanu, la sa inla, kipak in; ngai in, kei na lak ua teng ding in ka hong pai hi," TOUPA'N achi.
Huai ni chiang in TOUPA lam ah nam tampi akizomkhawm ding ua, ka mite ahi ding uh; na lak ah ka teng ding a, huchi in sepaihte' TOUPA'N na kiang ah kei ahon sawl chih na thei ding hi.
Huan gam siangthou a atantuam bang in TOUPA'N Judah aluah ding a, Jerusalem ahon tel ding hi.
Dai un, mi tengteng, TOUPA ma ah a-omna siangthou a kipan in amah akhanglou in athoukheta hi.
